approach.method_basis: The Parent generates fresh molecular graphs, fits a Gaussian process to the current session’s accepted scores, and selects maxima of correlated function draws. It learns a monotone output transformation with one positive linear coefficient and three tanh terms through a Jacobian-adjusted likelihood. It transforms the sampled law back to raw score units and uses its quadrature expectation for the inherited stalled top-forty eligibility rule. Fixed count covariance, real feedback, graph admission, survivors and breeding remain part of this Parent.
approach.novelty: Restrict that learned transformation to a unit linear coefficient and fit only the nine existing tanh coefficients. This isolates whether nonlinear shape can preserve the paid predictive advantage without the Parent’s learned contraction. The other frozen siblings change estimation, noise or eligibility; this Child changes only the statistical family’s fitted linear degree.

observed_bottleneck: The code Parent n-80d9b7174bc7 couples a learned linear slope with nonlinear shape, so its observed predictive improvement does not identify whether contraction is necessary. The original Search logs contain 435 attempted parameter vectors with d in [0.1,0.9666207011445788], all below one and 164 at the d=0.1 bound. Of 434 accepted fits, 413 are nonlinear and 21 affine; 410 successful nonlinear pools change the paid set against the same-state raw GP. Seed 2 deco_hop batch 10 exhausted the original 200-iteration cap, leaving ten laws missing. The 4340-pair observed subset has pinball 0.017020185586828437 versus 0.020002513763293206, which cannot establish the literal 4350-purchase test. All fifteen endpoints nevertheless completed: Parent macro 0.57216721801385 is below formal Anchor n-cf8d309c06de at 0.607030316211131, with recorded paired delta -0.03486309819728103 and task_safe=false. Preserve mechanism_result=inconclusive; current execution=mixed, direct_behavior=supported, downstream_behavior=undetermined, score=counterexample and contribution=undetermined. The fresh Search-only audit and underlying hashes are policy/scratch/r0068-03-improve-L01-plan/source-audit.json whose all_cell_audits list names each exact derived file and underlying original summary/log/trajectory; the frozen planning evidence remains policy/scratch/search_policy-2cee9c973668/evidence-audit.json and saved-warp-summary.json. This is an unresolved nested-model question, not proof that the solver or whole method is broken.

hypothesis: Apply exactly the frozen model-family restriction within m-000000000005: for the unchanged accepted-label raw mean m and population-SD/floor scale s, t=(y-m)/s, set g(t)=t+sum_{j=1}^3 a_j*tanh(b_j*(t+c_j)). Fit only theta=(a1,a2,a3,b1,b2,b3,c1,c2,c3), with a,b in [0,5] and c in [-5,5]. The linear coefficient is the literal constant d=1, never a fitted coordinate or a compensating scale. Retain the Parent likelihood 0.5*g(t)^T*C^-1*g(t)+sum(log(diag(L)))+n/2*log(2*pi)-sum(log(g_prime(t)))+n*log(s), C=L*L^T, with the identical fixed count covariance, noise and realized jitter. Here g_prime(t)=1+sum(a_j*b_j*(1-tanh(b_j*(t+c_j))^2))>=1; bounded tanh terms imply g(t)=t+O(1), hence strict monotonicity and an onto-real inverse. Condition on g(t), invert the original correlated latent samples and restore m+s*g_inverse. The same 128-point inverse-law expectation remains the raw mean consumed by K=3/M=40 eligibility. A pointwise monotone inverse preserves each draw row’s candidate ordering; any new paid identities must arise through the changed fitted latent posterior and its retained mean consumer. No covariance-amplitude or nugget compensation, new consumer, extra model/control, rank transform, post-warp normalization or regularizer is introduced.

finding_summary.headline: Nonlinear prediction works without learned contraction, but the endpoint score falls.
finding_summary.insights: Learned global contraction is not necessary for a lower complete same-paid pinball loss on this fixed-covariance host. That is narrower than preserving the full Parent advantage, because the two methods visited different adaptive states and no same-state ten-parameter control was fitted. The restriction frequently returned the exact raw law: six sessions had only one or two nonlinear batches, while other sessions maintained nonlinear exposure. All fits met the inherited acceptance rule, but several stopped by function reduction with large projected gradients; the result certifies this registered implementation, not globally optimal estimation. Improved paid prediction did not translate to better search progress: total incumbent increments were 5.320 versus 5.455, and late-half increments were 0.608 versus 0.879. The molecular audit also found stronger ring-family concentration in two objectives, no specified stereochemistry despite 2,066 molecules with potential unassigned centres, and larger extreme size tails despite smaller typical molecules. Those are observed limitations, not proven causes of the score loss. A proposal scheme capable of controlled ring-topology changes and stereochemical assignments addresses missing coverage capabilities; the current evidence does not establish its endpoint benefit. The negative score effect belongs to this nested restriction on this finite panel. Broader nonlinear-warp usefulness, retained-component contribution and predictive mediation remain open.
finding_summary.results: All 435 scheduled fits produced complete prospective laws, and all 4,350 purchased molecules joined to their original predictions. Nonlinear maps operated in 235 fits and changed 226 purchased sets, including 775 molecules absent from the same-state raw-GP choices. The other 200 fits were exact identity maps; their 2,000 purchases stay in the primary comparison. Mean pinball loss fell to 0.019242 from 0.019741 for the raw GP on the same purchased molecules, a decrease in every seed mean, although four of fifteen task/seed cells worsened. This supports the registered predictive hypothesis. It does not imply uniformly better uncertainty estimates: 90% interval coverage fell from 72.1% to 70.0%. The endpoint macro was 0.563160 versus 0.572167 for the code Parent, a paired loss of 0.009007; all three seed macros declined. The formal Anchor scored 0.607030. The trusted task comparison passed against the code Parent but flagged a material sitagliptin regression against the formal Anchor. The formal score criterion retains its separate, unmet literal Parent condition.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich neutral graphs concentrate N-halogen chemistry, leave stereochemistry unspecified, and retain extreme size tails.
molecular.overall_character: All five issued tasks and Search seeds 0, 1, 2 are represented by 300 accepted observations per cell: ten initial and 290 optimizer records. Thus 4,350 optimizer records plus 150 initials were inspected for the Child and separately for code Parent n-80d9b7174bc7. All 9,000 recorded molecules parse with RDKit 2023.09.6; this describes accepted trajectories and does not measure rejected-proposal validity or makeability. Child optimizer records contain rings in 4,266/4,350 and aromatic atoms in 4,244/4,350. Fused aza-aromatics, aryl carbonyl systems, fluorinated heterocycles and ring-associated amines are established output capabilities, not missing chemistry. All optimizer structures have zero net formal charge and zero specified atom chiral tags; 2,066 have at least one RDKit-perceived potential unassigned chiral centre. Neutral representations do not establish absence of ionizable groups or their solution protonation state. N-halogen connectivity occurs in 960 Child versus 425 Parent records; N-O single bonds in 456 versus 525. These are connectivity flags for chemical review, not proof that every flagged molecule is unstable or unsynthesizable. Child counts above 40/50/60 heavy atoms are 240/94/27 versus Parent 561/59/16: lower central size does not remove the extreme tail. There are 81 versus 61 records with at most five heavy atoms, and 827 versus 1,239 above molecular weight 500. Hundreds of typed scaffolds coexist with local family concentration, so neither complete scaffold collapse nor uniformly improved chemical breadth is supported. All quoted sizes, rings, functional-connectivity counts and scaffold counts below are derived RDKit measurements; the request digest string counters are not substituted for these properties. Typed/generic counts exclude empty Murcko scaffolds. Similarity below is the pooled mean of all within-task pairs after excluding records with fewer than ten heavy atoms, using binary radius-2, 2048-bit chiral Morgan Tanimoto. It is a descriptive convention, distinct from the model count kernel, and pooled top-30 sets are descriptive score-selected subsets rather than independent replicates. The frozen request states child_complete=true and paired_complete=true, matched seeds [0,1,2], no profile mismatches, and macro means 0.5631604622840157 versus 0.57216721801385, paired delta -0.0090067557298343. No task or seed is omitted from the comparisons below. These chemical associations do not establish mechanism activation, biological utility, causation of endpoint changes, or node eligibility. Frozen authority: policy/requests/r0068-03-improve-L01-molecular-assess-5e181af3904a0793.json. Complete input identities, original trusted paths, byte-preserved Child trajectory copies, archived Parent paths and hashes: policy/scratch/r0068-03-improve-L01-molecular/source-manifest.json. Pooled descriptor evidence: policy/scratch/r0068-03-improve-L01-molecular/chemistry-summary.json; each per-task entry also cites all three concrete audits with their underlying input files. The audits do not compute synthesis routes, stability, pKa, binding poses or any new objective value; the all-atom multiple-double-bond heuristic in the raw audit also includes sulfur oxo centres and is not interpreted here as an organic-cumulene count.

transferable_gaps.evidence: None of 4,350 Child optimizer records specifies an atom chiral tag, while 2,066 have a potential unassigned RDKit chiral centre. Parent likewise specifies none, with 2,421 potentially unassigned records. This is an observed shared limitation, not an explanation of the Child score delta.
transferable_gaps.gap: No demonstrated production of stereochemically specified molecules despite abundant potential stereocentres.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A task-agnostic generator could preserve and deliberately vary valid stereochemical assignments during graph edits, keeping distinct isomer identities and measuring their accepted coverage. No particular configuration or objective-specific stereochemical answer is supported by this audit.

transferable_gaps.evidence: N-halogen bonds occur in 960 Child versus 425 Parent optimizer records. Two pooled high-score sets each contain N-halogen bonds in all 30 molecules, compared with 4 and 2 Parent molecules. These are explicit bond-connectivity observations; no stability or synthesis outcome was measured.
transferable_gaps.gap: Chemically unusual connectivity is readily explored, but conventional alternatives are not consistently retained around high-score families.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Chemically typed edits should expose interpretable functional-group alternatives and preserve chemically coherent local connectivity, then audit what survives actual feedback. transferable_gaps.evidence: Child counts above 40 heavy atoms fall from 561 to 240, yet counts above 50 rise from 59 to 94 and above 60 from 16 to 27. The Child maximum is 88 heavy atoms. Several high-score subsets remain much smaller than these tails.
transferable_gaps.gap: Lower typical size coexists with uncontrolled extreme graph expansion.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Expose controllable molecular growth, contraction and ring-closure edit scales, and track their accepted size tails. Use broad task-agnostic structural control rather than deriving a fixed objective-specific size optimum from this finite panel.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Eighty-one of 4,350 Child accepted optimizer records have at most five heavy atoms, compared with 61 for Parent. The associated recorded scores include zeros, very small nonzero values and a nonzero baseline; a common zero-score interpretation would be false.
transferable_gaps.gap: Fragment collapse remains an observed output mode alongside elaborate ring chemistry.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Treat retention of meaningful connected molecular structure during destructive edits as a measurable generator capability, with deliberate size-reducing alternatives. The evidence does not justify declaring all small molecules invalid or globally unhelpful.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Two pooled output sets have 214/84 and 281/134 typed/generic nonempty scaffolds, versus Parent 354/181 and 442/271. Their fragment-excluded mean similarities rise from 0.2032 to 0.2381 and from 0.1650 to 0.2571. Other paired sets show similar topology counts or lower similarity, so this is conditional concentration rather than universal collapse.
transferable_gaps.gap: Many unique molecular strings and typed scaffolds do not ensure sustained exploration of distinct ring topologies.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Support alternative ring-topology edits while retaining useful local functional patterns, and track typed and generic scaffold coverage separately from substitution-level novelty. Chemistry breadth remains a diagnostic, not a guaranteed endpoint improvement or component-attribution claim.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
